title: Scope unsafe ratchet to actual baseline inputs
goal: The unsafe exposure ratchet runs only when a changed input can change cargo-geiger --forbid-only or its comparator: dependency manifests/lock, toolchain/build configuration, crate entry points, baseline, or the ratchet script. Ordinary module edits like admin/release.rs skip this multi-minute install+scan safely, while ambiguous scope continues to run.
